note: Seed matrix for pilot-critical topics; expand per chapter in Gate 8.

topics.reader_question: I'm broke / anxious about money. What do I do?
topics.felt_problem: shame, scarcity fear, confusion about God's will and wealth
topics.modern_teaching_high_level: cashflow clarity, habits, assets vs liabilities, abundance mindset
topics.philosophy_parallel: Aristotle habit/virtue; Bacon counsel; thrift tradition
topics.g2r: Provision and warning from Deut 8 through prophets, Jesus, apostolic contentment, Revelation critique of Babylon commerce
topics.scripture_establishes: diligence, honesty, anti-greed, trust, generosity, no life-in-possessions
topics.practical_action: honest numbers + one stewardship act + prayer
topics.confidence: HIGH for core ethics; MEDIUM for any specific finance tactic

topics.reader_question: Why do I keep choosing the wrong person / how do I date wisely?
topics.modern_teaching_high_level: attachment patterns, slow dating, standards, online dynamics
topics.g2r: covenant faithfulness motif from Genesis marriage gift through prophets to Revelation wedding hope
topics.scripture_establishes: heart-guarding, holy desire, covenantal love character
topics.practical_action: character vs preference lists; pause; counsel

topics.reader_question: My mind won't turn off at night.
topics.felt_problem: rumination, fear, spiritual slogans that don't land
topics.modern_teaching_high_level: habit loops, attention, meaning under suffering; Stoic control dichotomy
topics.g2r: fear and God's presence from Genesis through Psalms, Jesus' peace, New Creation hope
topics.scripture_establishes: prayerful petition, trust, honest lament, peace as God's guarding
topics.scripture_does_not_establish: anxiety always equals sin; no clinical care needed
topics.practical_action: two-column steward/entrust; specific prayer list; help-seeking if needed
